push.title: L 3-9 vs Inter Hornz | You: 7.0 (7th worst match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.0. A little below the line for a midfielder. We'll get you back above it.

THE GOOD
+ 9 tackles attempted (up from your usual 5). That's a team-first performance.
+ Most on-ball actions you've had in 18 matches for us (35). If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after PhogsToffees and BellyTb1 walked off. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 3 of the team's 4 shots: the team ran through you. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ 1 key pass chipped in +0.1. Every bit helps.

THE BAD
- Shot conversion 0%, down from your usual 36%. Fix it like this: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it.
- 61% passing (14 of 23, up from your usual 54%). Repeat after me: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 3 and set up a relegation match. A team result, and it needs a team answer.
- 0.4 below your norm. Chin up, eyes forward.
- Missed tackles 6, up from your usual 4. We can fix that.

Five-minute drill: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

Between you and me, tuxedo_slide: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

Patience with yourself, please. - Coach Lasso

Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out.

push.title: L 3-9 vs Inter Hornz | You: 6.5 (3rd worst match performance)
push.body:
A 6.5 from buddskees. Tough day at the office. Leave it at the office.

THE GOOD
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 40%). You won it clean and gave it back to us with a bow on top.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after PhogsToffees and BellyTb1 walked off. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Misplaced passes 2, from 8 in your previous match. More of that, please and thank you.

THE BAD
- Only 13 passes. Next match: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.
- Rating came in 0.6 below what your on-ball stats earned. Homework: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked. Water the plant.
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 3 and set up a relegation match. We win together and we wear this together.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 1. That needs to look different next time out.
- We shipped 9 goals to Inter Hornz and lost by 6. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.

Practice plan: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.

buddskees, one more thing before you log off: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

I believe in you, period. - Coach Lasso
